gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured pink on drawing No. CM 66, extending from Ching Cheung Road at the junction with Castle Peak Road and running firstly in a westerly direction, then turning to a southerly direction for a total length of 1,150 m. until it joins with Kwai Chung Road at the east bank of Lai Chi Kok Bridge.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道起點為呈祥道與青山道會合點，先向西伸展、後轉向南行至與荔枝角橋東岸之葵涌道會合為止，全長一千一百五十公尺，其位置在 CM 66 號圖則內用粉紅色標明。
